rules: 1. General Playing Rules::Matches will generally be played in accordance with the current FIVB Official Volleyball Rules, except where modified by the Brisbane Magpies Volleyball League Competition Rules.;Where there is any inconsistency, the Brisbane Magpies Volleyball League Competition Rules take priority.|2. Match Format::Each match consists of three sets: Set 1 to 25 points, Set 2 to 25 points, and Set 3 to 15 points when required.;Deuce applies where required. A team must win each set by 2 points.;Approximately 15 minutes of warm-up time will normally be provided before each match, subject to the competition schedule.;Players in the semi-finals and finals must have attended at least 2 matches in the first seven weeks. Substitutes with fewer than 2 attendances require opponent approval.;Each team is entitled to one 30-second time-out per match. The time-out must be requested by the team captain and approved by the referee.;Each team may use a maximum of one time-out per match.|3. Female Player Requirement::Each team must have at least two female players on court at all times during the match.;This requirement applies throughout the entire match, including all sets, rotations, and substitutions.;If a female player is injured or unavailable, she must be replaced by another eligible female player where required to maintain the two-female-player minimum.;A male player cannot replace a required female player for the purpose of satisfying this rule.;If a player is injured or unavailable and no substitute player is available, the team may continue playing with the player's position left vacant. However, the team will lose the right to serve whenever the rotation reaches the vacant position.;If a team cannot maintain at least 4 players on court for any reason, the team will forfeit the match.|4. Libero Rules - No Super Libero::Super Libero is not permitted.;Standard FIVB Libero rules apply, including restrictions on back-row play, attacking, and blocking.;Only one Libero may be on court at any time.;Libero replacements must not result in fewer than two female players being on court or be used to circumvent the female-player requirement.|5. Team and Player Responsibilities::Each team is responsible for ensuring that it has enough eligible players available to complete the match.;Teams should arrange sufficient substitute players to account for injuries, illness, late arrivals, and absences.;Having insufficient eligible players, including being unable to maintain at least two female players on court, may result in a match forfeit.;All participating players must comply with the eligibility requirements established by the League.|6. Referee Authority and Final Decisions::The referee has authority over the match and is responsible for interpreting and applying the playing rules during the game. All players and teams must respect referee decisions.;Where a situation arises during a match that is not specifically addressed by these Competition Rules, the referee may make a decision based on the FIVB Official Volleyball Rules, sporting fairness, player safety, and the circumstances of the match.;The referee's decision on all on-court matters is final.;Repeated arguing, abuse, threats, intimidation, or refusal to follow a referee decision may result in a warning, penalty, removal from the match, or further disciplinary action by the League.|7. Sportsmanship and Conduct::All players, coaches, and team representatives must:;Treat referees, opponents, teammates, organisers, and spectators with respect.;Follow reasonable directions given by referees and League organisers.;Avoid abusive, threatening, discriminatory, or aggressive behaviour.;Avoid deliberately dangerous play.;Demonstrate appropriate sportsmanship before, during, and after matches.;Serious or repeated misconduct may result in removal from the match or further disciplinary action.|8. Player Safety and Injuries::Player safety takes priority. A referee or League organiser may stop play where they reasonably believe that a player is injured or continuing play creates an immediate safety concern.;Players are responsible for assessing whether they are physically able to participate and should not continue playing where doing so may create an unreasonable risk to themselves or others.;An injury to a female player does not remove the two-female-player requirement.;If the team is unable to maintain at least two female players on court following an injury, the team will forfeit the match.|9. Waiver and Acknowledgement of Risk::All participating players must complete the Brisbane Magpies Volleyball League's required Waiver and Acknowledgement of Risk before participating in the competition.;Each team is responsible for ensuring that all players participating on its behalf have completed the required documentation.;A player who has not completed the required documentation may be refused participation.;Nothing in the waiver is intended to exclude any right or liability that cannot lawfully be excluded under applicable Australian or Queensland law.|10. Final Interpretation and Administration::The referee's decision is final for all on-court matters during a match.;For matters outside active match play, including player eligibility, competition scheduling, registration matters, off-court disciplinary matters, administrative matters, and administrative interpretation of the Competition Rules, the decision of the Brisbane Magpies Volleyball League organiser will be final, subject to applicable law.;All teams and players are responsible for reading and understanding these Competition Rules before participating.
